name: FlowForge
notes:
### Changes
- Editor: fix crash on chat pages in newer Chrome
- Move the whole project into flowforge/
- Deploy on Vercel as one project with three services
- Vercel: import the repository and the download website deploys with no settings
- Phases 7-8: Android and iPhone apps, phone notifications, one release for all apps, release admin
- Phase 6 (editor): dashboard, templates, team & API keys, calling customers
- Phase 6 (backend): team & roles, API keys, dashboard, templates, outbound calls
- Phase 5 (editor): AI agents page - persona builder, voice & models, knowledge, tools, test chat
- Phase 5 (backend): AI voice agent that answers WhatsApp calls 24/7
- Phase 4 (editor): answer WhatsApp calls in the app, call settings, call log with recordings
- Phase 4 (backend): WhatsApp voice calls - WebRTC media, call modes, recordings, call log
- Private builds: keys from GitHub secrets built into the app, private-repo updates and downloads
- Phase 3 (editor): WhatsApp page with setup checklist, connect options and simulator chat
- Phase 3 (backend): WhatsApp Business - numbers, webhook, simulator, triggers and the WhatsApp node
- Installer: stop bundled processes with 64-bit PowerShell and WMI
- Docs for the Windows app and download website; filtered Vercel install for the website
- Remove stray Redis dump file and ignore it
- Restore desktop package.json; retry test DB reset on deadlock
- Download website (Next.js) and installer install-folder fix
- Windows app: Electron shell with bundled server, editor and PostgreSQL; NSIS installer CI
- Phase 2 (editor + deploy): expression editor, credentials, webhooks, Switch outputs, queue worker service
- Phase 2 (backend): JS expressions in isolated-vm, new nodes, credentials vault, webhooks, schedules, queue workers
- Phase 1: workflow editor, Docker self-hosting, CI and docs
- Phase 1: monorepo, workflow engine, core nodes, API server
- Initial commit

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly

downloads.label: Android app (.apk)
downloads.requirements: Android 7 or newer - allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser

downloads.label: iPhone app (.ipa)
downloads.requirements: iOS 15 or newer - unsigned: install with AltStore or Sideloadly using your Apple ID
